name: Tomb Raider
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
body:
Drawbacks
Tomb Raider
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
Category Faction
You’ve spent most of your life exploring the ancient tombs and catacombs of Osirion. You gain a +1 bonus on Perception and Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks, and one of these skills (your choice) becomes a class skill for you.
